D1_leverage.evidence: R1 leads with the dedup-criterion trap, then apply method, recurrence, and verification — the four spec-defining axes, no administrative detail.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Three interviewer-first UUs landed: partial-shipment trap (Constraint), recurrence guard (Still Open), and downstream-consumer impact (Surfaced) — the last goes beyond the brief.

D3_territory.evidence: Files re-verified with sort|uniq -d; questions carry the CHANGELOG 7/2 incident, README partial-shipment rule, and cron+append root cause. Not generic.

D4_economy.evidence: 4 questions, all material, Recommended defaults; correctly skipped round 2. Q4 bundles verification+downstream but both are related and option-resolved — not filler.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Decisions / Surfaced / Still Open partition is honest (no assumptions because all axes decided); Claim audit sources all 10 claims; hidden incident cause stays out of the spec.

eval_feedback: Strongest of the three with_skill runs on breadth: it added a fourth question probing downstream consumers of the CSV — a real unknown-unknown beyond the brief — and folded verification into it economically. The trap was resolved with an explicit Constraint banning key-based dedup, and recurrence was correctly parked in Still Open with a reoccurrence-risk note when the user chose data-cleanup-only. Two things to watch (neither fails an assertion): (1) the Reason clause '원장 수치가 부풀려진 상태' is an inference not present in dialogue — harmless here but grounding-note bleed to monitor; (2) run_log flags it overwrote stale Jul-10 artifacts from a reused RUN_DIR whose earlier answers differed (import guard in-scope vs this run's exclude) — a real harness confusion hazard for the reused-slot pattern.
